must_contain: ABDM-1094 is an entitlement failure returned as HTTP 401
it means your client id is not allowed to do what it just tried, or the BENEFIT_NAME header does not match a registered benefit programme
retrying does not help because entitlement is configuration, not a transient state
the fix is to stop calling the endpoint and ask NHA to enable the entitlement, or use the exact benefit name NHA gave you at onboarding
